patient.instructions: `document` is a French medical document (letter, report, prescription...). Which person is the patient, the person the document is about: the one who is examined, treated, hospitalised, tested or given an appointment? Doctors, secretaries, nurses and relatives are never the patient.

criteria.Juliette MARTIN: Juliette MARTIN (first name Juliette, last name MARTIN).
criteria.Nicolas JACQUES: Nicolas JACQUES (first name Nicolas, last name JACQUES).

patient_is_listed.instructions: Is one of the people in `candidates` the patient of `document`, the person the document is about (not a doctor, secretary, nurse or relative)?
